dashboard.label: Time Based Question Answering
dashboard.description: Correct and incorrect submissions over time for the selected CTF.

search.query: index=scoreboard_admin ctf_id="$ctf_id$" Result="Correct" user!=admin BasePointsAwarded>0 | timechart useother=f limit=100 span=5m count by Number | streamstats sum(*) as *
index=scoreboard_admin ctf_id="$ctf_id$" Result="Incorrect" user!=admin Penalty>0 | timechart useother=f limit=100 span=5m count by Number | streamstats sum(*) as *
